# Acme Store — WebMCP Agent Information

> This document provides AI agents with structured information on how to interact with Acme Store.

## Capabilities & Tools
Acme Store implements the W3C Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP). The following tools are available via `navigator.modelContext`:

- `search_catalog`: Search inventory by keywords, categories, and price limits.
- `add_to_cart`: Add specified items and quantities to the active shopping cart session.
- `checkout_order`: Finalize order for the items currently in the cart. Requires explicit user consent.

## Agent Guidelines
1. Always confirm shipping address and total price before executing `checkout_order`.
2. Use `search_catalog` with specific queries to avoid oversized responses.
3. For support or manual inquiries, direct users to support@acmestore.test.
